national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Hold 10th Joint Working Group Meeting on Counter Terrorism
bullets: The 10th meeting of the India-Uzbekistan Joint Working Group on Counter Terrorism was held in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on countering extremism, radicalization, terror financing, misuse of technology, and transnational organized crime.
Both nations reaffirmed their commitment to cooperate in multilateral forums including the UN, SCO-RATS, and EAG.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Attends Nuakhai Celebrations in Chhattisgarh, Releases ₹200 Coin
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu attended the 'Sewa Samman Parv and Yuva Prabodhan' event in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, as part of the Nuakhai festival celebrations.
She released a ₹200 commemorative coin in honour of Pujya Mata Hasi Devi Ji at Chhattisgarh Mandapam in Lok Bhawan.
The President's itinerary also included visits to Maa Danteshwari Temple and participation in the traditional Muria Darbar as part of the Bastar Dussehra in Jagdalpur.

national_news.title: India Reaches 88 Medals at Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: India expanded its medal tally to 88 (21 Gold, 26 Silver, and 41 Bronze) at the Asian Para Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, securing 4th position.
Dharmaraj Solairaj set a new Asian record in the men’s T44/T62/T64 long jump combined event with a jump of 7.15 metres to defend his title.
Armless archer Sheetal Devi won double gold medals in the women’s compound individual and compound mixed team events alongside Toman Kumar.

national_news.title: India and Poland Agree to Double Bilateral Trade by 2030 and Enhance Strategic Ties
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in New Delhi, setting a target to double bilateral trade by 2030.
Both leaders agreed to boost strategic cooperation in critical and emerging technologies, defense innovation, cybersecurity, semiconductors, rare earth minerals, and nuclear energy.
India invited Poland to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI) to promote peace, freedom of navigation, and sustainable development in the region.

national_news.title: Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar Win Compound Mixed Team Gold in Aichi-Nagoya
bullets: Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar clinched the compound mixed team archery gold at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, defeating Indonesia 151-148 in the final.
The top-seeded Indian pair set a new World Record in the qualification round before claiming the gold medal.
Suvarna Raj won Gold in the women’s F-54 discus throw event, while Swati Chaudhary secured Silver in the women’s W-1 archery event.

national_news.title: MEA Facilitates Return of Stranded Umrah Pilgrims from Saudi Arabia
bullets: Over 3,000 stranded Umrah pilgrims returned from Saudi Arabia to India over a week, alongside 10,000 normal pilgrims on available flights.
Indian Embassy in Riyadh and Consulate in Jeddah established 24x7 control rooms and are actively assisting affected citizens.
Major Indian carriers suspended services to Saudi Arabia temporarily, while alternative options via Saudia and Flynas remain operational.

national_news.title: India and Poland Agree to Boost Cooperation in Defence, Space, and Nuclear Energy
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held comprehensive discussions in New Delhi, agreeing to double bilateral trade by 2030.
Both leaders condemned terrorism in all forms, including cross-border terrorism, and called for dismantling terrorist safe havens and financing networks.
India invited Poland to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative, expanding strategic cooperation into critical technologies, semiconductors, and rare earth minerals.

national_news.title: Centre Launches Nationwide 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan-Rabi 2026' from Haryana
bullets: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the nationwide 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan-Rabi 2026' from Karnal, Haryana, running until November 30.
The initiative promotes sustainable agriculture, soil health improvement, balanced fertilizer use based on soil testing, and crop diversification through oilseed and pulse missions.
Collaboration involves agricultural departments, Krishi Vigyan Kendras, ICAR institutes, and universities to conduct farmer conferences, Kisan Chaupals, and field demonstrations.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Polish PM Donald Tusk Hold Bilateral Talks in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in New Delhi to review bilateral relations and strategic cooperation.
Both nations agreed to deepen ties in defence, space, and nuclear energy, with invitations extended to Polish companies for co-development and co-production.
Poland is currently India's largest trading and investment partner in Central and Eastern Europe.

national_news.title: India Targets One-Trillion-Dollar Chemicals Market by 2040: Union Minister J. P. Nadda
bullets: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilisers J. P. Nadda announced India's target to develop a one-trillion-dollar chemicals market by 2040 during the 14th edition of India Chem 2026 in Mumbai.
Under the proposed 'Bhavya Rasayan' scheme, the Centre will provide Rs 1,000 crore for each chemical park, requiring a minimum state contribution of Rs 500 crore.
The theme for the 3-day event is 'Advantage Bharat: An Emerging Global Chemicals Hub'.
